attachments.insertion_landmark: deep/posterior base of patella, via quadriceps tendon

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population (deepest quadriceps head)
functional_compartments.function_note: Deepest of the 4 heads; articularis genus (small distal slip tensing the suprapatellar bursa) is sometimes described as a distinguishable 5th quadriceps component blending with this muscle's distal fibers.
